newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Hung Kai & Co places new shares.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hung Kai & Co places new shares.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Company has expanded its shareholder base and secured additional working capital of about HK$396 million through the issue of new shares, the company said.

AP Emerald Ltd, which holds 33.17 percent of the issued shares of Sun Hung Kai & Company, has entered into a placing and subscription agreement with Eagle World Pacific Ltd, the company said in a statement published on Wednesday.
Eagle World will purchase 129.47 million shares from AP Emerald, and AP Emerald will subscribe for 193.74 million shares.
As a result of this simultaneous placing and subscription, AP Emerald's shareholding in the company will be maintained at 33.17 percent.

The placing price and subscription price are HK$2.05. This price represents a discount of about 4.65 percent of the closing price of HK$2.15 per share on March 11. The placing shares represent about 13.37 percent and 11.14 percent of the existing and enlarged issued share capital of the company.
The net proceeds of the subscription, about HK$396 million, will be used as to HK$200 million to reduce bank borrowings and the remainder for working capital to expand the business of the group.
Sun Hung Kai & Company shares closed at HK$2.15 on Tuesday.
